jobs.description:
Saarland University is a campus university with an international reputation for research excellence, particularly in computer science and in the life sciences and nanosciences. The university is also distinguished by its close ties to France and its strong European focus. Around 17,000 students, studying over one hundred different academic disciplines, are currently enrolled at Saarland University. Saarland University is officially recognized as one of Germany’s family-friendly higher-education institutions and with a combined workforce of more than 4000 it is one of the largest employers in the region.

The Chair of Energy Materials is inviting applications for the following position commencing at the earliest opportunity.

Doctoral Research Position (m/f/x)

Reference number W2917, salary in accordance with the German TV-L salary scale1, pay grade: E13 TV- L, duration of employment: 3 years, volume of employment: 50 % of standard working time.

Your task: Next-Generation Battery Materials for a Sustainable Future

You will dive into the synthesis and characterization of novel battery materials that go far beyond conventional lithium-ion systems. This interdisciplinary PhD project addresses central challenges of the energy transition, including alternative battery chemistries (e.g., sodium-ion, magnesium-based systems), solid-state electrolytes, and circular recycling strategies

Job requirements and responsibilities:

 Designing and characterizing novel electrode materials or electrolytes for post-Li technologies

 Advancing circular battery concepts (e.g., direct recycling, recovery of critical raw materials)

 Fabrication of battery electrodes (water-based binder systems, dry electrodes, free-standing)

 Structural and electrochemical characterization using state-of-the-art instrumentation, including X-ray diffraction,

Raman spectroscopy, and Scanning electron microscopy

 Active participation in the research activities of the group and collaboration with external partners

 Publish scientific papers and present results at international conferences

Your academic qualifications:

 Completed scientific university studies in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or related

fields

 Language skills (according to GER): English (C1)

The successful candidate will also be expected to:

 Hands-on experience in electrochemistry, material characterization (e.g., XRD, SEM, BET), or process engineering

is advantageous

 Strong motivation for sustainable technologies and interdisciplinary collaboration

 Independent, analytical mindset and proficiency in English

What we can offer you:

 A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility of

teleworking

 Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions

 A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses)

 An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sports

programme

 Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK)

 Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV)

 Job bike leasing (JobRad)

We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a PDF file) by 09.11.2026 to ls-energymaterials-jobs@uni-saarland.de. Please include the reference number W2917 in the subject line of the e-mail.

If you have any questions, please contact us for assistance.

Your contact:

Herr Prof. Dr. Volker Presser

Materials Science and Engineering

Email: ls-energy-materials-jobs@uni-saarland.de

Pay grade classification is based on the particular details of the position held and the extent to which the applicant meets the requirements of the

pay grade within the TV-L salary scale. Part-time employment is generally possible.

If you have obtained a foreign university degree, a proof of the equivalence of this degree with a German degree by the Zentralstelle für

ausländisches Bildungswesen (ZAB) is needed before hiring. If necessary, please apply for this in time. You can find more information at

https://www.kmk.org/zeugnisbewertung.

Unfortunately, neither costs for attending an interview at Saarland University nor costs for any certificate evaluation by the ZAB can be reimbursed

in principle.

We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, and sexual orientation and

identity. In accordance with its policy of increasing the proportion of women, the University actively encourages applications from women.

Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration in the event of equal suitability.

When you submit a job application to Saarland University you will be transmitting personal data. Please refer to our privacy notice for information

on how we collect and process personal data in accordance with Art. 13 of the Datenschutz-Grundverordnung. By submitting your application you

confirm that you have taken note of the information in the Saarland University privacy notice

Grundkenntnisse: Materialphysik

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d) (Ausbildungsberater/in)
jobs.description:
About us The European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
is a joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon, and NXP. For the
first time, TSMC, the global technology leader, is establishing a
semiconductor fabrication plant in the heart of Europe, offering
leading-edge manufacturing technologies for next-generation
semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For our future fab
in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated:
Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d)
Are you ready to strategically and pedagogically lead the end-to-end
apprentice journey for Europe's newest, most advanced semiconductor
facility? As a Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational
Training (m/f/d) at ESMC in Dresden, you will move beyond standard
administration to drive collaborative success across all core phases
of our technical vocational education. You will be the architect of
our future talent pipeline— managing employer branding at schools,
coordinating dual-training plans, mentoring Gen-Z apprentices, and
ensuring legal compliance. Fitting into our fast-paced greenfield
environment, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the next
generation of microtechnology and industrial specialists from the
ground up! Tasks Talent Attraction & Recruitment: Design and execute
targeted school marketing strategies, represent ESMC at career fairs,
manage the applicant pipeline, conduct interviews, and issue
apprenticeship contracts. Onboarding & Pastoral Care: Serve as the
primary point of contact and dedicated mentor for future apprentices,
coordinating orientation phases and providing continuous coaching.
Training Curriculum Coordination: Design dual-training plans, manage
internal rotations across manufacturing departments, and coordinate
closely with local vocational schools (Berufsschulen).
Train-the-Trainer Support: Provide ongoing pedagogical and structured
guidance to our operational Fab trainers on the manufacturing floor.
Legal Compliance: Ensure full operational compliance with the German
Vocational Training Act (BBiG), the Youth Employment Protection Act
(JArbSchG), and other relevant educational laws. Key Stakeholder
Management: Build and maintain excellent collaborative relationships
with the local Works Council (Betriebsrat/JAV), vocational schools,
and local chambers (IHK). Graduation & Placement: Coordinate final
exam preparations, align with department managers to map out
post-graduation career pathways, and handle transition contract
processes. Profile Must-Have: Certifications: Holder of the AdA-Schein
(AEVO / Ausbildereignungsprüfung)—the mandatory qualification to
train apprentices in Germany. Education: Academic degree (B.Sc./M.Sc.)
or certified technical expert background (Staatlich geprüfter
Techniker) with a verified trainer/tester license. Experience: 5+
years of professional experience managing vocational training programs
within a technical, manufacturing, or industrial environment (e.g.,
semiconductor, automotive, automation, or chemical industries).
Regulatory & Institutional Knowledge: Strong, practical experience
working successfully with the IHK and a deep understanding of German
legal frameworks (BBiG, JArbSchG, and BetrVG). Languages: Fluent
German (C1/C2) is mandatory for official communications with
authorities, schools, and parents. Strong English skills (B2/C1) are
required for internal collaboration in our international corporate
environment. Pedagogical Drive: Exceptional communication skills with
the ability to motivate, resolve conflicts, and guide Gen-Z young
adults through their personal and professional development.
Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with cleanroom environments, semiconductor
fab safety regulations, and the technical demands of Microtechnology
(Mikrotechnologe/In). Experience setting up apprenticeship structures
in a fast-growing, ramp-up corporate environment. We offer Security &
Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement
opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company
Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial
well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee,
you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an
exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Support for
Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you
will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training &
Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper
understanding of the processes involved in operating complex
semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you
continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An annual
budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes,
massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals & Transportation:
Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public
transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume.

jobs.occupation: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Einkauf und Logistik)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) Are
you ready to secure the supply chain for Europe’s pioneer
semiconductor Greenfield project? As a Global Procurement Specialist /
Strategic Buyer, you will take ownership of the commercial end-to-end
sourcing process for critical materials supporting our brand-new
manufacturing site in Dresden. You will negotiate high-volume global
contracts, mitigate supply chain risks, and build resilient
partnerships with key international suppliers. If you thrive at the
intersection of business strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and
high-tech operations, this role offers you the ultimate platform to
make a global impact. Tasks Strategic Sourcing: Develop, negotiate,
and execute end-to-end global sourcing strategies and contracts to
ensure a highly resilient, cost-effective supply of critical
materials. Supplier Partnership Management: Build and nurture
long-term strategic relationships with a global supplier base to
secure high-quality materials and services. Commercial Negotiation:
Lead commercial negotiations, drive total cost of ownership (TCO)
optimization, and actively manage commercial risks. Performance
Monitoring : Evaluate and manage supplier performance against key
quality, delivery, cost, and risk metrics to ensure full contract
compliance. Risk & Supply Resilience: Proactively identify and resolve
supplier-related issues, including delivery disruptions and quality
deviations, using data-driven preventive actions. Cross-Functional
Alignment: Collaborate closely with engineering, fab operations,
finance, and HQ procurement teams to align sourcing activities with
production budgets and timelines. Process Excellence: Contribute to
continuous improvement initiatives to streamline procurement workflows
and scale up supply chain operations. Governance & ESG: Ensure strict
compliance with all internal policies, contractual obligations, trade
laws, and ESG standards across all purchasing activities. Profile
Required: Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Supply Chain
Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, IT, or a
related field. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of strategic procurement
or supply chain experience within an international industrial setting.
Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in commercial negotiations,
contract management, and strategic supplier evaluation. Languages:
Proficiency in English (C1) and German (C1) is required for seamless
collaboration with local and global stakeholders. Mindset: Strong
analytical thinking, attention to detail in contract review, and the
ability to coordinate multiple complex projects simultaneously.
International Onboarding: Willingness to complete an intensive
training of 3-6 months at TSMC Taiwan. Nice to have: Industry
Knowledge: Prior experience in the semiconductor, chemical, or
advanced materials industry. Certifications: Professional supply chain
or procurement certifications (e.g., APICS CPIM/CSCP, ISM CPSM).
Global Mindset: Experience in collaborating with Asian business
environments; Mandarin language skills are a plus. Why Join ESMC? Help
build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe.
Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across the
world. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
Additional contact details Please apply with an English resume.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Are you passionate about cardiovascular science and dedicated to ensuring patient health and safety? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
Our CRM team is seeking an experienced Lead Patient Safety Physician with expertise in cardiovascular, renal, and/or metabolic diseases. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to one of Boehringer Ingelheim's priority assets in late-stage clinical development, making a meaningful impact on patient safety worldwide.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.
Tasks & responsibilities

- Lead, manage, and provide medical-scientific direction to a team of Patient Safety Physicians responsible for a compound/asset, including project management, project-specific guidance, team coaching, and review of team output
- Play a key role in global regulatory submissions across all regions
- Develop proactive patient-centric risk minimization strategies for assigned assets on a global scale
- Enhance the value of BI assets through robust assessment of the benefit-risk profile
- Design evidence strategies that differentiate the asset through its benefit-risk profile, considering the scientific knowledge for the molecule, medical safety landscape, population, regulatory landscape, and patient perspective
- Generate safety evidence and perform safety & efficacy analyses to support decision-making by patients, regulators, HCPs, payors, and HTA bodies
- Ensure patient safety while adhering to the highest quality and ethical standards

Requirements

- Medical Doctor with strong clinical and/or clinical research experience
- Profound experience in patient safety at a pharmaceutical company on a global/corporate level, including clinical development and post-marketing safety
- Comprehensive understanding of pharmacovigilance regulations in major markets and the need for compliance
- Broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, and interest in future trends and developments in pharmacovigilance
- Clinical or research experience in the cardio-renal-metabolic field
- Proven leadership, people management & project management skills
- Excellent collaboration, communication, and negotiation skills
- Strong ethical sense with a quality and patient centricity mindset
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Ready to contact us? 
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until October 30th. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to September 15th are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the month of August/ beginning of September
Step 3: Panel interviews in the beginning of the month September

jobs.occupation: Control Specification Engineer (f/m/d) Gas Turbine Auxiliaries (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Control Specification Engineer (f/m/d) for Gas Turbine Auxiliaries, you work on open-loop control and protection specifications throughout the entire lifecycle of auxiliary systems, from concept development to commissioning support. You collaborate with engineers, suppliers, instrumentation specialists, and commissioning teams to align technical requirements and ensure seamless system integration. Some days are dedicated to specification development and documentation, while others involve resolving operational challenges, supporting project teams, or addressing site issues. You work in an international environment with colleagues from diverse technical and cultural backgrounds.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for reference engineering and control specification development for gas turbine fuel systems
* Technical ownership of auxiliary systems, including control, protection, and functional performance aspects
* Coordination and clarification of interfaces with engineering teams, suppliers, commissioning personnel, and other stakeholders
* Creation and maintenance of automation specifications, parameter lists, interface documentation, and related technical documents
* Support for customer-specific engineering requirements and project adaptations
* Back-office support for site activities, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues

What You Bring

* Degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering, or a comparable technical field
* Professional experience in control and protection system design with knowledge of relevant engineering disciplines
* Strong analytical mindset and systematic approach to solving technical challenges
* Ability to develop practical and innovative solutions while considering implementation risks
* Strong communication and coordination skills for interdisciplinary collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
* Highly proficient written and spoken English with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

2026 As a Process Engineer, you will play a critical role in
establishing, sustaining, and continuously improving advanced
semiconductor manufacturing processes. With deep technical expertise,
you will use data-driven analysis and structured problem-solving
methodologies to optimize manufacturing performance and support stable
high-volume production. As part of a high-volume 24/7 fab operation,
the role focuses on ensuring tool performance, improving uptime,
reducing defects, and supporting stable production. The position
requires openness to scheduled and occasional shift work, on call
duty, includes an initial induction and training period in Dresden of
one month, followed by one year of on-the-job training in Taiwan. If
you are interested in advancing your career in semiconductor
manufacturing, learning from one of the world’s leading
semiconductor companies, and joining an international and diverse team
on a unique learning journey, apply now with your English CV. Tasks 1.
Design and execute experiments, interpret complex results, and derive
actionable insights from data sets to optimize manufacturing processes
and achieve precision control at atomic levels. 2. Apply statistical
process control methods to establish and sustain robust and stable
manufacturing processes. 3. Qualify and sustain manufacturing
processes to support capacity expansion while maintaining speed,
stability, and quality. 4. Collaborate effectively with equipment and
material suppliers and internal engineering partners to identify
technology gaps, process limitations, and improvement opportunities,
and evaluate sustainable solutions. 5. Drive continuous improvements
in process stability, capability, yield, productivity, quality,
reliability, and safety. 6. Support manufacturing operations in a 24/7
high-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment, including
scheduled evening shifts, weekend support, on-duty, and on-call
responsibilities based on business needs. Profile 1. Legally eligible
to work in Germany. 2. Available for approximately one year of
on-the-job training in Taiwan. 3. Open for scheduled and occasional
shift work, on call duty. 4. Degree in electronics, electrical
engineering, mechanical engineering, mechanics, mechatronics, material
engineering, or an equivalent field. 5. Practical experience in a
mechanical or equipment-related field. 6. Understanding of technical
documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge of semiconductor
manufacturing is a plus. 8. Fluent in English with good command of
German. 9. Hands-on working attitude with an open mindset. 10. Strong
communication and interpersonal skills. 11. Able to perform physical
work on tools in a cleanroom environment. Important Candidate
Information: Start Date: This role is planned to commence on October
1, 2026, in Dresden. Depending on your needs and timeline preferences,

employment will be spent in Dresden. Following this initial

residence) or who terminate a personal lease contract in Dresden prior
to their planned departure to Taiwan. Furthermore, ESMC will organize
and provide air and ground transportation from Dresden to Taichung
(Taiwan) and back at the conclusion of the training. Accommodation in
Taiwan will be provided in one of TSMC’s modern and comfortable
company dormitories. Role Requirements and Expectations: This is a
unique opportunity to gain exposure to TSMC’s world-leading advanced
manufacturing practices and actively contribute to building ESMC from
the ground up. As a start-up organization, ESMC offers the opportunity
to play an active role in shaping the company’s culture, future
organization and ways of working. Candidates should be comfortable in
a dynamic environment where certain operational details such as
processes, documentation, shift structures, will continue to evolve
during the ramp-up phase. This role is ideal for individuals with a
